payload.text: The molt run, hv's: molt upgrade --self && molt upgrade && molt maintain on rhadamanth, gyges and kovacs, now to Molt 1.4.2 (released 12:17Z, formula at homebrew-molt 4e7e77d). Read-only pre-flight at 1.4.1's code, which 1.4.2 carries: rhadamanth's doctor and dry-run resleeve pass, pplr and cldr included. One blocker, hv's: Molt-matts' config/arngz/desks/zeopit.yaml is modified and uncommitted (still at 12:20Z), and molt upgrade refuses a user config repo with uncommitted changes. gyges and kovacs: every repo the run pulls is clean. gyges' resleeve installs brew pplr and removes Molt's old link ~/.local/bin/pplr -> ~/Devel/prj/Pplr/bin/pplr; its maintain takes cldr 0.2.0 and ccusage 0.1.5 to 0.2.2 and 0.1.8. kovacs enables neither pplr nor cldr. vc confirms each sleeve read-only over ssh after its run.
